blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — A bill establishing a national geriatric center moved closer to enactment after being ratified by the Bicameral Conference Committee on Tuesday. According to House Speaker Faustino “Bojie” G. Dy III, the ratification is a step forward in fulfilling a promise made during the necrological service for the late Batanes Rep. Ciriaco Gato Jr., who chaired the House Committee on Health. “Congress will continue what you started when we passed during the 20th Congress the proposal to establish the Dr. Eva Macaraeg-Macapagal National Center of Geriatric Health and Research Institute (DEMM-NCGHRI), an institution that will provide specialized healthcare for […]...
